craft_notes: Sthāyin: wonder at color (the red vision). Sanskrit first: image (pomegranate), nature (jāti-red, fork resolved), rank (third), essence (contemplation) → L4 sets image+nature line 1, rank+essence line 2. Rows: row 8 (vowel arc bloom/nature glows warm, then cools to contemplation). Rupture: semicolon after 'nature' — seeing done, counting starts. Close: end-weight on the doctrine ('contemplation' — what form IS). Minimal pass: 'burns' added to 'red' (radiance implied by dāḍimī-blossom + sdv); essence line untouched. Read aloud: line 1 blooms red, semicolon breath, line 2 stills. Rejected: 'jasmine-red' — killed at L0 (clashes with pomegranate); 'meditation' for cintana — killed: contemplation is the older, plainer word.

lines: Red as pomegranate bloom, the Bulb burns by nature;
the third is form — and form is contemplation.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dāḍimīkusumaprakhyaṃ kandaṃ vai jātilohitam / etadrūpaṃ samākhyātaṃ tṛtīyaṃ cintanātmakam

reads_against.argmap: The bulb in form-vision is pomegranate-red, and form is the third member, consisting of contemplation.
c1_essence: Pomegranate-red bulb, third member — form as contemplation itself.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with vīra-utsāha (wonder braced by resolve)
